_README: REVIEWED value corrections for docs/sf_fundamentals.json cells (npStd/npCon).
NOT for scale errors -- those are scale_fix.json (power-of-ten, applied at PARSE time).
This ledger is for cells whose stored VALUE is simply wrong against the filing itself:
the wrong period, the wrong line, or a mis-transcription. Every entry states the primary
document and a SECOND independent document, because a single quote can be a typo and a
restatement looks exactly like an error until you check whether the later filing agrees.
Applied by scripts/apply_fund_cell_fix.py, guarded on `was` so it is idempotent and can
never overwrite a value someone else has since corrected. Measured 2026-08-23: pre-2016
cells in sf_fundamentals.json are NOT regenerated by the nightly (HINDUNILVR 20071231 held
473.79 unchanged across 40 commits), so a written correction persists; wiring this ledger
into build_fundamentals.py is still the durable follow-up for any era that IS rebuilt.

fixes.why: BSE ann 2007-10-31 12:48 (own-quarter filing): 'net profit of Rs 4080.60 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2007' = 408.06 cr. SECOND, independent: BSE ann 2008-10-24 12:37 (the Sep-2008 filing) repeats it as the comparative, 'as compared to Rs 4080.60 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2007'. Not a restatement -- both documents agree.
fixes.found: quantmac cross-validation residue, HUL Dec-FY transition era audit 2026-08-23

fixes.why: BSE ann 2008-02-13 12:42 ('Hindustan Unilever announces Q4 & FY 07 results' -- Dec-2007 was the LAST quarter of HUL's December-ending fiscal year, before the switch to a March year-end): 'The Company has posted a net profit of Rs 6314.40 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2007' = 631.44 cr. SECOND, independent: BSE ann 2009-01-27 (the Dec-2008 filing) carries it as the comparative, 'as compared to Rs 6314.40 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2007'. The stored 473.79 corresponds to no line in either filing.
fixes.found: quantmac finding 3 residue (HINDUNILVR Jan-2009 trade), audited 2026-08-23

fixes.why: BSE ann 2009-01-27 08:44 (own-quarter filing): 'net profit of Rs 6157.40 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2008' = 615.74 cr. SECOND, independent: BSE ann 2010-01-27 08:12 (the Dec-2009 filing) repeats it as the comparative, 'as compared to Rs 6157.40 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2008' -- so it is NOT a figure the company later restated to 632.24. Note the stored 632.24 sits suspiciously close to the PRIOR year's 631.44, consistent with a comparative-column mis-read.
